paragraph: Sampson James carried a red backpack through a period of homelessness. It held his meager possessions. It also carried his salvation. A fellow Indiana graduate recognized him, and their fraternity, in both senses, changed everything. Steve Hartman found the story on the road. Some memories travel with us waiting to be shared.

seed.summary: See that red backpack there? Sampson James used it to carry around his meager possessions during a stint of homelessness. Little did James know at the time this photo was taken, however, that it was also carrying around his salvation. This remarkable story of fraternity—philosophical and literal—comes from Steve Hartman’s “On the Road” segment at
seed.sourceTitle: Chance Encounter Between 2 Indiana Graduates Rescues Former College Ball Star from Homelessness
